title: 바닷속에서 터널을 연결하면, 사이의 물은 어디로 갈까?

scenes.narration: 바닷속에서 터널 두 개를 연결하면, 사이에 있던 물은 어디로 갈까요?
scenes.prompt: Original explanatory 3D cutaway of immersed tunnel connection: question

scenes.narration: 지금 덴마크와 독일 사이에서는 터널 조각을 바다에 가라앉혀 잇고 있습니다.
scenes.prompt: Original explanatory 3D cutaway of immersed tunnel connection: lower

scenes.narration: 먼저 양쪽 입구를 임시 벽으로 막습니다. 터널 안은 마른 상태죠.
scenes.prompt: Original explanatory 3D cutaway of immersed tunnel connection: walls

scenes.narration: 두 조각을 맞댄 뒤, 고무 패킹으로 둘러싸인 연결 공간의 물을 빼냅니다.
scenes.prompt: Original explanatory 3D cutaway of immersed tunnel connection: drain

scenes.narration: 그러면 바깥 수압이 새 터널을 밀어, 패킹을 더 꽉 눌러줍니다.
scenes.prompt: Original explanatory 3D cutaway of immersed tunnel connection: pressure

scenes.narration: 방수가 확보되면 임시 벽을 걷어내 길을 잇습니다. 바닷물을 막는 데, 바닷물의 힘을 이용하는 겁니다.
scenes.prompt: Original explanatory 3D cutaway of immersed tunnel connection: open

scenes.narration: 한 조각이 이백십칠 미터입니다. 배처럼 양 끝을 막아 띄운 뒤, 해저의 홈에 내려놓는 거죠.
scenes.prompt: Sealed concrete tunnel element lowered into gravel trench, illustrative cutaway.

scenes.narration: 막힌 벽 두 개 사이에는 바닷물이 남습니다. 바로 이 작은 공간을 바깥 바다와 먼저 분리해야 합니다.
scenes.prompt: Close view of trapped water between two bulkheads; exterior gasket highlighted.

broll.prompt: Photorealistic marine civil engineering documentary, vertical 9:16, one continuous 6 second underwater shot. Baltic teal blue water, realistic suspended particles and soft sunlight shafts, excellent visibility close to structures. Two enormous RECTANGULAR pale concrete immersed tunnel elements sit almost aligned in a gravel seabed trench. Far section stationary on the left, nearer section slowly lowered into alignment beside it from above, suspension cables extending up out of frame. Both end faces are fully closed with dark ribbed temporary steel bulkheads. Large black perimeter rubber gasket at connection, yellow safety paint on lifting brackets. Camera glides gently toward the small space between closed ends. Show immense scale, weight, realistic textured wet concrete and steel. No round pipes, no exposed flooded interiors, no open roads, no cars, no people, no explosions, no fantasy machinery, no writing or logos, no voice or music. Balanced clear blue-green shadows and warm neutral concrete highlights, cinematic natural lighting. Concept reconstruction, not actual filmed site.

claims: Fourth element immersed; nearly 900 metres in place
Water pumped from sealed space between bulkheads
External hydrostatic pressure pushes elements together
Project uses Gina gaskets and Omega seals

visualLimits: Simplified single-bore longitudinal section; not measured site reconstruction
Seal colored orange for visibility; actual gasket is rubber
Pressure arrows and water particles are explanatory; not a fluid simulation
Secondary sealing and structural completion precede bulkhead removal; stages compressed for teaching
